working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineage 21A (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any hemilineage A (Notch ON) neuron that develops from neuroblast NB4-3 during the postembryonic phase of neurogenesis.

justification: The authors' predicted hemilineage 21A (lineage markers and fast-acting neurotransmitter, Figure 4): its secondary (postembryonic) neurons. Also the authors' neurotransmitter for this cluster (glutamate): adult glutamatergic neuron (additional match).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00051459 hemilineage 21A secondary neuron (exact match).

additional_matches.fbbt_definition: Any glutamatergic neuron of the adult.
